description: This file implements a gRPC-like IPC server using protobufs, handling client connections, disconnections, and providing a service with methods for echoing text, handling file descriptors, and no-reply calls. It also sets up a socket for client communication and runs an event loop.

classes.name: MyExampleServiceServer
classes.description: A server implementation of the ExampleService, providing methods for echo, file descriptor handling, and no-reply calls.

methods.name: exampleEcho
methods.description: Converts the input text to uppercase and responds with it, logging the request and response.

methods.name: exampleWithFd
methods.description: Receives a file descriptor from the client, writes a message to it, and responds with the server’s stdout file descriptor.

methods.name: exampleWithNoReply
methods.description: Logs a message indicating a no-reply request; does not send a response.
